latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of awp-workflow-builder: generate complete AWP-compliant multi-agent workflows from natural language.

- Converts user descriptions into full AWP workflow directories, including workflow.awp.yaml, agent configs, prompts, and schemas.
- Supports generation of custom tools and skills on request.
- Follows the AWP 7-layer model with detailed compliance levels and strict workflow rules.
- Guides users through a structured interactive questionnaire to clarify requirements before generation.
- Compatible with various execution modes and agent orchestration strategies.
- Allows tool implementation customization and language selection for prompts and outputs.
